summary: Full functional test of UX batch (TASK 1 collapse card + persistence, TASK 1b global collapse-all toggle, TASK 2 notification single/select/all delete, TASK 3 recurring reminder API persistence, TASK 4 detach/redock floating window). Backend: 5/5 pytest passing. Frontend: all core flows working end-to-end against preview URL as admin (serkan). One testid-naming deviation from the review request found in NotificationBell (functional, not broken).

integration_issues.issue: Review request specifies data-testid=notification-select-mode and data-testid=notification-delete-{id} plus checkbox testid; actual implementation uses data-testid=notification-select-toggle (button) and data-testid=notification-select-box-{id} (checkbox). Individual delete testid notification-delete-{id} is correct. This does not break functionality — select-mode + delete-selected + delete-all all worked in live tests (6 -> 5 via delete-selected, then -> 0 via delete-all, toast '5 bildirim silindi', empty state 'HENÜZ BILDIRIM YOK' shown). Only a naming mismatch between spec and code that may confuse automated tests / documentation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If the tester-facing spec is authoritative, rename NotificationBell testids: notification-select-toggle -> notification-select-mode and notification-select-box-{id} -> notification-check-{id}. Otherwise update the review-request spec to reflect the shipped testids.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is now ~3103 LOC — continues to grow. Detach state (detachedIds), collapse state (collapsedIds), reorder DnD, context menu, and reminder UI could reasonably be split into dedicated files/hooks for maintainability.

In the tasks PATCH endpoint (tasks_router.py:512), status enum is hardcoded inline ('pending','done','paused','overdue') — consider centralising in tasks_models.py to avoid drift between backend and frontend labels.
Detached window state is intentionally transient (per problem statement) — good; but consider persisting positions/sizes to localStorage as a future UX polish (currently they reset on reload).
NotificationBell delete-all button fires immediately without an in-page confirm (only browser confirm dialog if any). Consider a small inline confirm step for destructive bulk action.
Testid naming inconsistency: notification-select-toggle vs the spec's notification-select-mode. Align to reduce automation-suite friction.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional on all TASK 1/1b/2/4 flows and TASK 3 UI element presence (persistence via backend)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded 3 notifications via direct MongoDB insert (id prefix TEST_notif_) to verify delete-* flows because backend has no notification-create endpoint. All test notifications were cleaned up (delete-all in UI + delete_many verified 0 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login button label is 'GİRİŞ YAP' (Turkish dotted-I) — use button:has-text("YAP"). Always dismiss data-testid=overdue-alert-close after login before clicking [data-testid=tab-tasks]. Card-level collapse buttons share the prefix task-collapse- with the toolbar wrapper testid task-collapse-toolbar and the global button task-collapse-all — filter out both when iterating UUID-based cards. NotificationBell testids that actually exist in code: notification-bell, notification-badge, notification-popover, notification-select-toggle, notification-select-bar, notification-select-all, notification-delete-all, notification-delete-selected, notification-close, notification-item-{id}, notification-select-box-{id}, notification-delete-{id}, notification-unread-dot-{id}, notification-perm-approve-{id}. Recurring reminder input testid is ctx-reminder-repeat inside the ⋮/right-click menu's reminder submenu. To seed notifications for QA: insert directly into db.notifications with user_id, id, title, message, created_at, read_at:None — cleaner than triggering server-side events.
rca of the issue: N/A — no reproduced bugs. Only a testid-naming spec/implementation mismatch documented under integration_issues; functionality intact.
